releaseNotes: The GitToto Recovery modal now opens immediately when you click Pull or Push — it no longer waits for the first progress event or for the git command to finish, and the toolbar loading spinner appears in the same frame as the click.
Fixed Pull/Push progress incorrectly showing 100% when the operation actually failed or was cancelled — progress now freezes at the last real value instead of jumping to complete.

Fixed a failed Pull/Push showing every step as still "pending" instead of marking the step that actually failed — the real failing step is now shown as failed, completed steps stay completed, and steps that were skipped due to an early stop (no upstream, dirty working tree, diverged branches, unrelated histories, nothing to push) are now shown as skipped instead of stuck pending forever.

GitToto Recovery: Pull and Push now show a real, step-by-step progress modal — real repository info, a live percentage driven by actual git progress output, and a 9-step process list — instead of a generic spinner.

Redesigned Pull/Push recovery decisions (Merge vs Rebase, Stash vs Commit-first, choosing a matching Upstream branch) as Decision Cards showing risk level, a stated reason when a strategy is recommended, and real consequences. Selecting a strategy now only selects it — a separate confirm step is required before anything runs.
Replaced the last remaining native confirmation popups (discarding an unsaved file edit, force-deleting a branch, undoing a commit) with the app's own themed confirmation dialog.
Fixed the Recovery modal's "View recovery guidance" button doing nothing on a failed Pull/Push — it now expands Technical Details to show the real failure reason.
Unified icon and status-color usage across the Recovery modal and toast notifications, and added a distinct Success toast color.

GitToto Recovery: Pull/Push/Merge and other write operations are now scoped per repository instead of app-wide — you can run a Pull on one repository while a Push runs on another, including across linked worktrees. Closing a tab is still blocked only while that specific repository has an operation running.
Fixed Pull incorrectly showing a "diverged history" dialog when local had commits simply ahead of the remote (nothing to actually merge).
Fixed a rare Pull-with-Auto-Stash race where a real stash re-apply conflict could be reported as a clean success.
